description: Examines the Ramsay household, the passage of time, loss, and Lily’s painting through shifting consciousness and the problem of representing experience. Covers To the Lighthouse: The Promised Journey; To the Lighthouse: Dinner and the Night; To the Lighthouse: Time Passes; Woolf’s Two Clocks: Consciousness, Perspective, and Form.
